name: Pizza Zillertal Lanersbach
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Pizza Zillertal Lanersbach in Tux!**

Indulge in authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the **Zillertal** valley. Our cozy pizzeria in **Lanersbach** offers delicious homemade pizzas, fresh pasta, and a selection of fine Italian wines—all while enjoying the breathtaking mountain views of the **Tuxer Alpen**.

Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a gourmet **Quattro Formaggi**, our wood-fired pizzas are baked to perfection. Pair your meal with a crisp **Aperol Spritz** or a rich **Chianti Classico** and savor the alpine atmosphere.

After your meal, explore the stunning surroundings—hike through the **Tuxer Alpen**, take a dip in the **Tuxer Badesee**, or enjoy a scenic drive along the **Zillertal** roads. We look forward to welcoming you!

**Pizza Zillertal Lanersbach**
*Your Italian escape in the mountains*
